artifacts.summary: 10-phase plan flipping lean-lsp from one global ~/.claude.json entry to per-project .projects[<path>].mcpServers entries written by a user-level SessionStart hook, inverting the verifier, tests, and recorded invariants that currently enforce the single-global model.

memory_candidates.content: On this machine, a Claude Code hook that must fire in EVERY session (including a fresh git worktree with no .claude/ deploy) cannot be contributed through an extension's settings-fragment.json: that merges into a repo's .claude/settings.local.json, which a worktree without a deploy never has. It must be registered at user level in ~/.claude/settings.json -- but that file's `hooks` key is home-manager-ENFORCED (~/.dotfiles/modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix activation.claudeSettings resets [_NOTE, env, hooks, model, permissions, statusLine] from ~/.dotfiles/config/claude/settings.json on every rebuild), so a durable user-level hook must be written to the dotfiles source and optionally mirrored into the live file for immediate effect. Related constraint: a session's MCP tool registry is a startup snapshot, so a SessionStart hook that writes MCP registration may only take effect in the NEXT session in that directory -- verify empirically with a fresh `claude -p`, never a running session.
